## Hypothesis

The TRENDLINE_BREAK_GATED candidate aims to capture the edge in trendline breakouts by filtering out low-quality breakouts and focusing on high-confidence trendline breaks. The hypothesis is that this filter will improve the overall performance of the trendline breakout strategy.

## Mechanism

The TRENDLINE_BREAK_GATED candidate uses a combination of indicators to filter out low-quality trendline breaks. The mechanism involves:

1. Identifying trendlines using a proprietary trendline detection algorithm.
2. Evaluating the quality of the trendline break using a combination of indicators, including:
	* Trendline slope
	* Breakout candle characteristics (e.g., candle body size, wick length)
	* Volume confirmation
3. Filtering out low-quality trendline breaks based on the evaluation results.
